description: E-Bike Field Study Data is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Bicycles and Pedestrians", published or maintained by U.S. DOT Volpe Center. GPS pings collected by study participants who rode conventional and e-bikes at Minute Man National Historic Park between April and September 2022. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Bicycles and Pedestrians". It has 21 columns, among them age, narrow, constrained_tunnel, spd, lat, date. The portal shows 2023-07-28 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT Volpe Center. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
